query: WITH candidates AS (SELECT s.snapshot_id FROM document_snapshots s JOIN documents d ON d.document_id=s.document_id WHERE s.state='ACTIVE' AND s.created_at < now() - ($1::bigint * interval '1 second') AND s.snapshot_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.preferred_snapshot_id AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT newer.snapshot_version) FROM document_snapshots newer WHERE newer.document_id=s.document_id AND newer.state='ACTIVE' AND newer.snapshot_version>s.snapshot_version) >= 2 ORDER BY s.created_at, s.snapshot_id LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE document_snapshots s SET state='REJECTED' FROM candidates c WHERE s.snapshot_id=c.snapshot_id AND s.state='ACTIVE' RETURNING s.snapshot_id
